name: Hooks Demo (behaviour patches)
author: neostryder (RPGM Tools)
description: A framework proof, not a mod anyone plays: it keeps the ModHooks entry-point path exercised now that the game bundles no real mods. Two rules, two kinds of hook, and the engine taken from ctx.core the way a downloaded mod must take it. Dev builds only.

rules.title: Demo object-list tiebreak
rules.description: Delegates to the engine's own objectListStandardCompare through ctx.core, which is the point: a mod reaches the engine by being handed it, never by importing it. Proves an ORDERING hook and a real core call in one.

rules.title: Demo message transform
rules.description: Upper-cases the message text. Proves a TRANSFORM hook, the fold that composes several of them in load order, and that a rule the player switches off contributes nothing at all.

rules.title: Demo mid-turn failure (breaks this session on purpose)
rules.description: Makes this mod's message hook throw on the next message. Switch it on to watch the containment: the hook is neutralised and switched off, the game STOPS SAVING for the rest of the session, and a screen names the mod and offers a reload. Your existing save is not touched. Dev builds only, and off unless you turn it on.
